distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records Anisandrus eggersi under the source name Terminalinus eggersi from Hunan, Guizhou, Fujian and Xizang. Smith et al. (2022) adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Honghe. The reviewed current distribution is the union of these confirmed records.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) reports Cinnamomum camphora, Meliosma cuneifolia, Aralia chinensis and Ficus carica. Smith et al. (2022) provides no additional host for this record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus eggersi (Beeson, 1930).

taxonomic_history.name: Anisandrus eggersi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) used Terminalinus eggersi; this source-specific combination is retained as provenance without changing the stable VSN.
